description: This Java class 'List9' extends ListActivity and implements ListView.OnScrollListener, providing a custom list activity that displays a floating letter indicator when scrolling through a list of cheese names. It manages overlay window views and handles scroll events to show/hide the indicator.

classes.name: RemoveWindow
classes.description: Inner class implementing Runnable to remove the overlay window displaying the scroll indicator.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list adapter, overlay view, and window manager, and prepares the overlay for display.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets the readiness flag to true when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Clears the overlay and resets the readiness flag when the activity pauses.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes the overlay view from window manager when the activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onScroll
methods.description: Handles list scroll events, updating the overlay with the first letter of the visible items, and manages timing for overlay visibility.

methods.name: onScrollStateChanged
methods.description: Empty implementation for handling scroll state changes.

methods.name: removeWindow
methods.description: Hides the overlay view by setting visibility to INVISIBLE.
